flawless: *The Yotian Soldier clicks back to its post, gears ticking evenly. Not a rivet is out of place.*
*A brass plate on its chest flips over to read DUTY. It turns smartly away.*
solid: *The Yotian Soldier oils a dented joint with a whirr and resumes its watch, vigilant as ever.*
*Clanking a little worse than before, the construct marches back to its station.*
close: *The Yotian Soldier's gears stutter and slip. It stands its ground, swaying, steam leaking from its seams.*
*Barely holding together, the soldier ratchets back into guard position, one bolt at a time.*
